propositions: rebar cannot reconcile against self-hosted Jira Data Center, which differs from Cloud on REST v2/wiki-markup bodies, PAT bearer auth, and name-based user identity instead of accountId.

Rather than forking a second adapter that reaches into adapters/jira/ privates, DC support is added via an explicit adapters/jira_family/ shared sub-seam with a machine-checked import contract preventing dependency inversion.

The local-to-Jira status and priority value maps already exist in three drifted copies; the epic consolidates the two adapters/ copies into one jira_family definition and adopts deleted->Done as the single declared observable change.

Location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) must not change path or touch _loader.py; they are shared by dependency inversion (parameterized by jira_family contracts) rather than relocation.

Variation is captured by RichTextCodec and UserIdentityModel contracts, with classify_probe_response parameterized by an operator-configurable resolved-status set defaulting to {Resolved, Done, Cancelled}.

The DC transport requires https for reconciler.base_url unless allow_insecure is set (logging a warning), never disables certificate verification, and reads the PAT only from the JIRA_PAT environment variable.
